title: Tis Good, Lord, to Be Here
description: Tis Good, Lord, to Be Here in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 5 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Joseph Armitage Robinson, first published in 1888. The tune, POTSDAM, is by Johann Sebastian Bach (1750). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: 'Tis good, Lord, to be here, Thy glo-ry fills the night; Thy face and gar-ments, like the sun, Shine with un-bor-rowed light.

lines: Thy face and garments, like the sun,
We fain would hold the vision bright
And make this hill our home.
But since Thou bidst us leave the mount,
Come with us to the plain.
